game.title: Lenger Bazi
game.description: The famous Afghan kite fighting game where participants coat their kite strings with a glass-and-glue mixture to cut opponents' strings, immortalized in 'The Kite Runner.'
howToPlay: Step 1: Players prepare their kites and specially coated strings with a mixture of glue and crushed glass.
Step 2: Each player launches their kite into the sky, maneuvering to gain height advantage.
Step 3: The goal is to cross strings with an opponent and pull sharply to cut their line.
Step 4: Players constantly reel in or release string to control kite position.
Step 5: Skilled kite flyers use complex maneuvers to entangle opponents.
Step 6: When a string is cut, the losing kite floats away, chased by children on the ground.
Step 7: The winner's kite remains flying, and they continue challenging others.
Step 8: Tournaments can involve dozens of kites competing simultaneously.
Step 9: Special signals are used to communicate with ground assistants.
Step 10: The last kite flying is declared the champion.
